verdict.rationale: YPOG's own Transactions page says it regularly advises on 'the largest German equity financing rounds' and is 'well advised from inception to exit.' Its seedstrapping briefing addresses when a priced equity round beats convertibles at seed, and its Venture Deals in Germany page covers cap tables, signing/closing mechanics and market-standard terms, so the core priced-round practice is evidenced. However, the only named matters (Langdock's seat relocation and SE holding, Isembard's market entry) are not financing rounds, and no deal counts or stage-by-stage coverage appear. Missing for 10: stated deal volume, named representative seed/Series A/late-stage financing transactions, explicit seed-through-late-stage coverage, independent corroboration.
